Representative Dusty Johnson | Skip to main content Image Johnson Votes to Ensure Only U.S. Citizens Vote in U.S. Elections Dusty Johnson voted to secure the integrity of American elections by passing the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act to prevent noncitizens from voting in federal elections. The SAVE Act requires proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote. Image Johnson Reforms Expedite Border Construction Dusty Johnson introduced legislation to ensure generational security of the southern border. The Furthering American Security by Tempering Environmental Regulations (FASTER) Act would require future administrations to maintain and enhance the border wall and border technology. Image Johnson Protects Women’s Sports at U.S. Military Service Academies Dusty Johnson introduced the Protection of Women in Sports at Military Academies Act to prohibit biological males from competing in women’s sports at United States military service academies. Image Johnson Continues Efforts to Protect American Agriculture from China U.S. Representatives Dusty Johnson (R-S.D.) and members of the Select Committee on China introduced the Protecting U.S. Farmland and Sensitive Sites from Foreign Adversaries Act to protect American farmland, military facilities, and critical infrastructure from malign attempts to control American land by foreign adversaries like China. Image Johnson, Roy Lead Bill to Ban Individual Stock Trading in Congress Dusty Johnson, Chip Roy (R-TX), and Seth Magaziner (D-RI) re-introduced the bipartisan TRUST in Congress Act to prohibit Members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent children from trading individual stocks during their time in Congress. Image Johnson Votes to Sanction Chinese Companies for Their Role in America’s Fentanyl Crisis Dusty Johnson voted to pass the Stop Chinese Fentanyl Act to hold China accountable for its role in the fentanyl crisis.
